inputs.text: More than 58 lakh names have been removed, yet the tribunals meant to hear challenges remain shut while officials keep discussing where to put them. The Supreme Court has issued its direction and the appeal software is supposedly ready, so this looks less like a genuine obstacle than a managed delay. They can point to a process and call it fair while people are left with no practical way to contest their exclusion. The stalling itself serves the purpose.
